svg.title: Fix the Process Before Adding Cars
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-08-fix-before-scale-roadmap; chapter number: 12; chart type: timeline_roadmap; title: Fix the Process Before Adding Cars; subtitle: Four weeks of systems before the fleet grows; caption: Operators running 15 to 300+ cars agree scale only works once systems exist; King of Rentals warns that adding cars to a bad process just adds fuel to the fire.; assumptions note: The four-week grouping is an editorial sequence of practitioner gates and pro-tips, not a timeline any single operator reported.; note: King of Rentals (706e4cdleYQ @ 00:00:22, OBbGsDAi0xA @ 00:08:08), Etienne Elsaesser (3dvvSrh_cus @ 00:06:44, VUKM00PHEmI @ 00:25:20, 3dvvSrh_cus @ 00:09:28, VUKM00PHEmI @ 00:07:36), and Car Rental Coach (lOTgf5qQVJ8 @ 00:02:35).; weeks: week: Week 1; title: Audit the operating process; deliverable: Timestamped check-in and check-out evidence on every rental; gate: No new cars added onto a process that is no bueno; week: Week 2; title: Lock payment and guest insurance; deliverable: Phone each guest's insurer, confirm the policy is not brand new, ask about exclusions, and pull a binder; gate: No reservation without payment, with the deposit taken on rental day; week: Week 3; title: Staff with per-job vendors; deliverable: Per-job 1099 vendors for cleaning, delivery, and turnaround; gate: Do not get employees; week: Week 4; title: Protect the asset and the account; deliverable: OBD2 tracker concealed behind a splitter, plus an oil, coolant, washer fluid, and wiper check on every returned car; gate: Never cancel from the host side; call Turo to cancel instead
